achievements.name: First pair
achievements.detail: Flip two cards that show the same picture and clear that pair.

achievements.name: Level one
achievements.detail: Clear the first training board and land on the level complete screen.

achievements.name: Beat the clock
achievements.detail: Finish a board while time is still left on the timer.

achievements.name: Low flips
achievements.detail: Clear a board after turning over only a small number of extra cards.

achievements.name: Animal cards
achievements.detail: Clear a board whose pairs use the animal card designs.

achievements.name: Shape cards
achievements.detail: Clear a board whose pairs use the geometric shape designs.

achievements.name: Bigger grid
achievements.detail: Clear a later board that lays out more cards than the opening grid.

achievements.name: No fail
achievements.detail: Finish a timed board and get the level complete result.

achievements.name: Higher score
achievements.detail: Beat a score the progress tracker already saved for that board.

achievements.name: Several boards
achievements.detail: Clear a run of training boards in one sitting as the layouts grow harder.

achievements.name: Hardest grid
achievements.detail: Clear the most crowded board in the training list.
